title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S03, Swarm rule benders
thread:
**Issue #3542 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3542: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S03, Swarm rule benders
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the Swarm cards that bend Evolve's rules.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #3 | High Evolutionary |
| #75 | J-lease S-Space EX-plorer |
| #75.1 | J-lease S-Space EX-plorer Pack |
| #87 | Frontier Flora |
| #93 | Recessive Replicators |
| #163 | Accelerationist (the list's second #92) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E1 (#3536): Evolve, the repeat Aura and the evolved-this-game counter.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #3 High Evolutionary: its Cry evolves a friendly permanent of your choice (one not yet evolved). The Aura makes each of your Evolve texts run 2 (Radiant 3) times.
- #75.1 the Pack: "Stinkyscape or Stinkyscape+ cards" draws from both sets' collectible cards. Its base face makes them Radiant, and the Radiant face also makes them cost (0).
- #87 Frontier Flora: Animated, so it is a Unit on the field with 3 Attack and 3 Health per Plague Counter on it (an Aura it keeps).
- #93 Recessive Replicators: "that Unit" is the friendly Unit whose death evolved it. Its gained Death resummons a fresh copy of it.
- #163 Accelerationist: renumbered from the second #92 (SP5). It counts every card of either player that evolved this game.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(3) High Evolutionary, Unit, Swarm, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #3**
7/7
**Cry**: Evolve a friendly permanent.
**Aura**: Your evolutions trigger twice.
~~~
14/14
**Cry**: Evolve a friendly permanent.
**Aura**: Your evolutions trigger thrice.

**(3) J-lease S-Space EX-plorer, Unit, Human, Swarm, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #75**
5/5
**Cloaked**
**Evolves** when you launch a Starship.
**Evolve:** Put a **J-lease S-Space EX-plorer Pack** on top of your deck.
~~~
10/10
**Cloaked**
**Evolves** when you launch a Starship.
**Evolve:** Put a Radiant **J-lease S-Space EX-plorer Pack** on top of your deck.

**(2) J-lease S-Space EX-plorer Pack, Token, Spell, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #75.1**
**Cast on Draw:** Add 5 random **Radiant** **Stinkyscape** or **Stinkyscape+** cards to your hand. *{or Stinkyscape++ cards if we add it}*
~~~
**Cast on Draw:** Add 5 random **Radiant** **Stinkyscape** or **Stinkyscape+** cards to your hand. They cost (0)

**(1) Frontier Flora, Field Spell, Swarm, Common, Stinkyscape+, #87**
**Animated**
**Evolves** when a **Starship** is launched.
**Evolve**: Place 2 Plague Counters on this.
**Aura**: Has 3X/3X stats for each Plague Counter.
~~~
**Animated**
**Evolves** when a **Starship** is launched.
**Evolve**: Place 4 Plague Counters on this.
**Aura**: Has 3X/3X stats for each Plague Counter.

**(2) Recessive Replicators,** **Unit, Swarm, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #93**
4/4
**Evolve** when a friendly Unit dies.
**Evolve**: Gain “Death: Resummon that Unit.”
~~~
8/8
**Evolve** when a friendly Unit dies.
**Evolve**: Gain “Death: Resummon that Unit. Make it Radiant.”

**(3) Accelerationist,** **Unit, Human, Swarm, Common, Stinkyscape+, #92**
6/6
**Aura**: Has +2/+2 for every card that **Evolved** this game.
~~~
12/12
**Aura**: Has +4/+4 for every card that **Evolved** this game.
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3536

Part of #3534.
````
